summary: Chicktionary is back! Master your skills or learn English in a fun way!
description:
JOIN MILLIONS OF FANS. DISCOVER THE ENDLESS WORDPLAY OF CHICKTIONARY!

Master your skills or learn English in a fun way!

Try two fresh ways to enjoy this award-winning word game: JOURNEY across the farm in a spelling adventure, or race the clock in QUICK PLAY. If you’re feeling nostalgic, give CLASSIC mode a try!

********************************************************************
– TIME Magazine, Top 25 iPad Apps for Kids
********************************************************************

SCRAMBLED WORDS
Learn as you play! Hatch new words to complete each puzzle.

SPECIAL CHICKENS
A cast of eggstra special chickens are here to help you out! Mix and match their powers to rule the roost.

ENDLESS WORDPLAY
With more words, more puzzle variation, special chickens, and three remastered game modes, Chicktionary will keep you pecking away until the cows come home!

FARM FRESH FUN
Chicktionary has been refined in every way: from beautiful new design and animations to the eggstra rewards of finding additional words beyond the puzzle.

EGGSTRAS:
– New and remastered game modes provide endless fun for word puzzle fans.
– Keep your eggs in a row! Google Play saves your progress, no matter which device you’re on
– All of our content is accessible without in-app purchases. You can buy shortcuts or remove the ads, but 100% of the game is available through play alone.
– Contact us from within the game if you have any trouble

********************************************************************
Questions? Suggestions? Send us a message using the “HELP” button in the Settings menu.
